title: Biostrap Recovery Score Recovery Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=biostrap:daily recovery_score=*
| stats sum(recovery_score) as total_value, avg(recovery_score) as avg_value by user_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks user values by total and average recovery score across Biostrap recovery score events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `recovery_score` values for each Biostrap recovery score event and review total and average recovery score by user.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total recovery score.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly which user shows the biggest recovery score numbers in your Biostrap recovery score data.
